author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಷ್ಟ ಬರುವುದೆ ಮನವ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿಸಲೆಂದು
ನಷ್ಟನಿನಗಾಗುವುದು ಕುಗ್ಗಿರಲು ಮನವು
ಯಷ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿರೆ ಮನವು ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ದೂರವಿಡೆ
ಇಷ್ಟ ಸಾಧಿಪೆ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Hardship comes to make the mind strong;
the loss is yours if the mind shrinks;
if the mind is a firm staff that keeps hardships away,
you will achieve what you desire, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Difficulties exist to strengthen us. A shrinking mind loses; a mind as firm as a staff holds hardship at bay and reaches its goal.
